gate_candidate: FA (009 Phase 3 shortlist, 'not confirmed' pending spot data verification)

trade.description: Long spot / short USDS-M perpetual, same symbol, delta-neutral by construction. Return = funding received - basis mark-to-market - costs (NEXT_PROMPT.md sec 3.2). Binance convention: positive funding pays shorts, so this is the long-basis direction only; reverse carry (negative funding) is out of scope, sec 3.5.
trade.headline_capital_convention: fully-collateralised, unlevered return on deployed capital (denominator = 2 units of capital per unit of paired notional: 1 spot + 1 perp margin at 100%). Levered 3x/5x variants are a Phase 5 sensitivity row only, reported with the sec 6.3 liquidation analysis attached or not at all.
trade.interval: 8h (native on both spot and futures/um klines; funding settles every 8h; no resampling)

constants.ROUND_TURN_BP_derivation: 2 * (SPOT_TAKER_BP + SLIPPAGE_BP + PERP_TAKER_BP + SLIPPAGE_BP) = 2 * (10+1+5+1) = 34.0 bp per full open+close cycle
constants.CARRY_EWMA_HALF_LIFE_NOTE: 21 is a HALF-LIFE (7 days at 8h bars), passed to polars ewm_mean(half_life=21, adjust=False). Not a span, not a window length.
constants.TARGET_HOLD_NOTE: 45 periods = 15 days = ~1.3x the ~34-period (~11.3 day) break-even hold derived in sec 3.4. Declared, not swept.
constants.THETA_IN_derivation: K/H = 34 bp / 45 periods = 0.755555... bp per 8h = 7.55555...e-5 as a fraction. Entry threshold on the causal carry EWMA.
constants.THETA_OUT_derivation: THETA_IN / 2 (hysteresis band, sec 5.3). A position exits only when carry falls below half the level that would have opened it.
constants.LIQUIDITY_FLOOR_NOTE: Trailing 30-day median dollar volume, required on BOTH legs independently (spot AND perp). Declared before any return is computed (NEXT_PROMPT.md sec 4.3); not tuned. Sensitivity at $1M and $25M reported in Phase 5, counted into n_trials, never as an alternative headline.

screens_in_order: 1. spot leg must exist on Binance (symbols failing this are dropped and counted -- 'N of 128 symbols have no spot leg' is itself a capacity finding)
2. trailing 30-day median dollar volume >= $5,000,000/day on each leg independently (the pre-declared liquidity floor above)
3. no survivorship filtering -- LUNA, FTT, and every delisted name stay in the panel for as long as data exists; delisting is a forced exit at the last available price (sec 6.4)
universe_construction.reporting_requirement: cap the universe at whatever survives screens 1-2 and state the count; do not backfill toward a round number

book_construction.weighting: equal weight across all currently-qualifying symbols, capped at MAX_POSITIONS_N_MAX=10 simultaneous positions (top 10 by carry if more than 10 qualify)
book_construction.unallocated_capital: cash earning zero -- no T-bill/stablecoin yield credited
book_construction.fill_convention: next bar's open, never the decision bar's close
three_books_reported_side_by_side: timed -- the pre-registered design above (the headline)
always-on -- hold the paired position in every screened symbol at all times, never timing entry (isolates whether timing adds anything over just being in the trade)

gates.name: mechanism
gates.claim: Positive funding carry exists net of basis drift, before costs.
gates.fires_if: Pooled mean paired gross return > 0 with Newey-West |t| > 3 on the development panel.

gates.name: tradeable
gates.claim: The timed book is a tradeable, cost-surviving strategy.
gates.fires_if: Net Sharpe > 0.5 at EVERY origin offset in [0,1,2,3] AND block-bootstrap 95% CI on net excess return over cash excludes zero AND DSR > 0.95 at the honest n_trials.
gates.known_caveat: DSR (research.deflated_sharpe_prob) is documented in NEXT_PROMPT.md sec 11.4 as likely over-rejecting for a trial family of near-identical origin offsets. Used unmodified anyway (fixing it is deferred to notebook 017). If FA-2 fails ONLY on the DSR leg while every other leg passes, that must be recorded prominently and explicitly, and NOT acted on (no threshold relaxation, no estimator patch).

gates.name: timing adds value
gates.claim: Timing beats always being in the trade.
gates.fires_if: Paired block-bootstrap 95% CI on (timed - always-on) net return excludes zero, in favour of timed.

gates.name: genuinely neutral
gates.claim: The book is not a disguised long.
gates.fires_if: |beta| to the equal-weight crypto basket < 0.10 AND |beta| to BTC < 0.10, both on net returns.
gates.note: Validity check: if FA-4 fails, FA-2 does not count regardless of its Sharpe.

gates.name: institutionally fundable absolute performance (009 flag)
gates.fires_if: Net Sharpe > 0.5 at every offset AND DSR > 0.95 AND a stated, bounded max drawdown.
gates.note: Reported ALONGSIDE FA-2, never instead of it, per 009's own recommendation.

holdout_access_rule: requires FA-2 AND FA-3 both firing on development. FA-1 alone is a mechanism finding, not a strategy. If they do not both fire, Phase 6 is skipped entirely, the holdout directory (src/research/cache/basis18/holdout/) is never read by any Phase 4/5/6 loader other than run_phase_6_18_holdout.py, and this is stated explicitly in the write-up.

n_trials.baseline_derivation: 3 books (timed/always-on/cash) x 4 origin offsets = 12, plus 6 Phase 5 ablations (no-hysteresis, perp-leg-only, excluding LUNA/FTT, cost sensitivity at 4 levels counted as configurations, levered 3x/5x, by-year decomposition) = 18
n_trials.rule: revised upward only, never downward, if any additional configuration is run for any reason (013's precedent: 18 -> 25, disclosed)

scope_discipline: do not rebuild AdaptiveTrend or anything in the trend/momentum/adaptive-parameter family (013 Design C is already a stronger null than a fresh rebuild could produce)
do not reopen the directional question (015 closed it within a stated MDE bound)
do not test reverse carry (sec 3.5 -- an infrastructure/capacity finding, not a strategy to build)
do not risk-gate returns with src/risk/ (sec 6.4 -- tested twice by 007 Gate RG and hurt twice)
do not fix the Deflated Sharpe estimator (sec 11.4 -- that is notebook 017)
do not modify src/risk/ or src/regime/ (import only)
do not touch the holdout unless FA-2 and FA-3 both fire (sec 9.3 makes this a filesystem fact via a dedicated, greppable-in-one-command runner)
do not sweep K, H, theta_in, theta_out, or N to improve the headline (sec 5.2 -- they are derived once, above, and frozen)
do not drop LUNA/FTT/delisted names from the panel (report with and without, per 013's template)
one notebook -- no 019 work, no dashboard changes, no productionisation inside this run

objection_2_1.question: Doesn't 007 Phase C already show funding carry is null?
objection_2_1.answer: No -- 007 Phase C tested a structurally different trade: a cross-sectional, dollar-neutral book in perpetuals ONLY (long low-funding names, short high-funding names), which is a bet that funding predicts price DIRECTION. It was net Sharpe-negative in all 24 configurations, with realized turnover ~674-681/yr (about 40% higher than the price-based signal it was compared to) because a rank-based book churns whenever cross-sectional funding rates cluster. Gate FA is a per-symbol, spot+perp, delta-neutral position that collects the funding PAYMENT itself; there is no cross-section to rank against and therefore no rank-churn failure mode to inherit. What DOES transfer from 007 is its own prescribed fix (sec 357-359): a no-trade band tuned to carry's own update frequency. Sec 5.3's per-symbol absolute-threshold hysteresis (qualifies()) is that fix, built without calling alpha_lib7.hysteresis_weights (which is cross-sectional/rank-based and would reintroduce 007's own failure mode).

objection_2_2.question: Isn't this just crypto beta with extra steps?
objection_2_2.answer: If it is, Gate FA-4 catches it and the notebook fails on validity grounds regardless of Sharpe. A basis book with |beta| to the equal-weight crypto basket or to BTC >= 0.10 (on net returns) is not the delta-neutral trade this notebook claims to test, and the most likely cause of a beta leak is an implementation bug (funding sign inverted, basis mark-to-market dropped, same-bar fills -- sec 11.2), not alpha. This check is load-bearing, not decorative -- 013 Design D used the identical beta check to confirm its own -1.52 book was genuinely losing on a cross-sectional bet rather than eating basket beta.

expected_headline_range.statement: Do not expect Sharpe 6.45 (E1's headline). The sec 3.4 cost arithmetic implies a realistic development-window expectation of roughly 4-6% annual return on deployed capital at 2-4% volatility, net Sharpe approximately 1.0-2.0 and plausibly under 1.0. If the backtest prints Sharpe > 4, treat it as a bug first (sec 11.2: funding sign inversion, dropped basis mark-to-market, same-bar fills, or a forward-filled delisted spot leg) and investigate before reporting.
expected_headline_range.e2_prediction: E1/E2 (Borri, Liu, Tsyvinski & Wu, arXiv:2510.14435) report the carry Sharpe fell to 4.06 by 2024 and turned NEGATIVE in 2025 -- squarely inside this repo's 2025-07-01+ holdout window. A holdout failure here is an informative, pre-predicted result, not a disappointment, and Phase 3's by-year pooled-funding check is a direct, cheap replication of this specific Tier-1 claim on this repo's own data.

permitted: risk.ewma_vol for causal volatility of the basis series (machinery reuse, no commodity-specific calibration claim)

risk.model.fit_risk_model + risk.densities to characterise the basis-shock tail descriptively, for sizing a margin buffer on the short perp leg -- cited to notebook 006 (Distribution Zoo, crypto), NEVER to 008 (Gate RE/CE/CT, commodity futures, does not transfer)
forbidden: using any risk/ output to time entry, exit, or position size for return-seeking reasons -- sizing a margin buffer is a solvency question; standing down on predicted risk is a return-timing question, tested twice (007 Gate RG, 013) and lost twice

cost_accounting_note: research.add_portfolio_costs applies one cost_frac = taker_fee + slippage per unit of turnover, but this trade has two legs with different fees (10bp spot vs 5bp perp). basis_lib18 does explicit two-leg cost accounting (not a single blended rate) and uses add_portfolio_costs only as a cross-check; this is stated in the results per the 012 flat-convention-reapplied-to-instruments-it-was-never-built-for precedent.
